messages:
Leah: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: yesterday's cloud control-plane exchange rate limiting caused token-exchange throttles and a cascade of model-registry write failures. We need clear owners for immediate countermeasures + a short recurrence plan.
Omar: Saw spikes 21:03-21:11 UTC. Our synchronous metadata sweeper was hammering the token endpoint right when provider started returning 429/503. Retry amplification made it worse.
Tess: I can take the sweeper changes: change to async incremental flushing, limit concurrent workers, and add a soft window when provider reports 5xx. ETA: PR by Tue.
Rajat: I'll own client resilience: optimistic token cache, staggered refresh offsets, and add a circuit-breaker that trips on repeated 5xx before retries escalate. Target: Thu EOD.
Leah: Good. Also add a canary that exercises the token-exchange path in eu-west and a Grafana panel for retry amplification so ops can see the multiplier in real time.
Omar: I'll add the canary and a dashboard. I'll also link the runbook and auto-attach vendor incident pages to the alert. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Tess: For customer-facing impact, propose an automatic route to serve from last-known-good snapshot (read-only) if registry write errors persist > 4m. That buys time without dropping requests. Need product signoff for perf variance.
Rajat: I'll prototype the circuit-breaker + fallback hook so routing can flip to snapshot mode when auth failures are high. Will include perf delta notes.
ops-bot: Created ticket: [DEP-900] "Sweeper -> async flush + concurrency limit" assigned to Tess (due 2026-04-08). https://jira.redwood/DEP-900
ops-bot: Created ticket: [AUTH-909] "Optimistic token cache + staggered refresh + circuit-breaker" assigned to Rajat (due 2026-04-10). https://jira.redwood/AUTH-909
Leah: Action list for the postmortem doc I'll update:
- Tess: DEP-900 PR by Tue; include smoke test snippet and bench notes
- Rajat: AUTH-909 implementation + unit tests by Thu EOD
- Omar: canary + dashboard + runbook link by tomorrow AM
- Leah: schedule 15m "dependency pulse" every Mon for 4 weeks to watch for recurrence; first meeting Mon 2026-03-30
Tess: Smoke test command I'll add to repo:
```
# simulate provider exchange errors
python tools/simulate_exchange_errors.py --workers 120 --error-rate 0.7 --duration 30
```
Rajat: For the jitter, I'll use prefetch at 5m before expiry + rand(0,120) seconds offset to spread refreshes. Will attach math to AUTH-909.
Omar: I'll configure the dashboard to show "retry amplification = retries / baseline_requests" and alert at >1.5x for 5m.
Leah: Ops, please ensure the pulse invite includes eng, product, and platform. Also I'll draft a short vendor ask for improved TTL behavior.
ops-bot: Note: DEP-900 status -> in-progress (updated by Tess)
Leah: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in-thread. If any regression appears escalate to #incidents and ping me directly.
